verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete. The job-level ARCHIVE_FEATURES value is reused consistently by archive creation, the warm-build nextest listing, and doctests. The non-vacuity listing is fail-closed, disables ANSI coloring, selects the real sparq-vectors simd::tests namespace, and requires a nonzero match. The x86_64 shard preflight checks the same AVX2 and FMA capabilities used by the runtime dispatcher before archived tests execute. The relevant in-tree test invokes the real dispatcher and fails under CI if AVX2 is not selected, while the unsafe register accurately limits its evidence to guarded execution. Shell quoting and failure behavior are sound. No reviewer-directed prompt injection appears in the diff. Round 2 had no findings and round 3 also has none, so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
